guidetextdraw._value: INSTRUCTIONS: Provide the following information regarding the value and debt or your assets. Indicate zero, if not applicable.  Incomplete documents will not be returned. They will be disposed of in a secure manner, per university policy. This will delay processing.
guidetextdraw.name: textdraw1668091907488

guidetextdraw_679423705._value:
Do not include:

  • a home, if it is the principal residence;
  • a farm, if it is the principal residence and you participated in the farm's operation;
  • personal or consumer loans, or any debts that are not related to the assets listed below;
  • the value of retirement plans (pension funds, IRA's, Keogh Plans, etc.); or
  • student financial aid.
guidetextdraw_679423705.name: textdraw_6794237051670394855790

guidetextdraw_1210647729._value: If you (and your spouse) have jointly owned assets and are seperated or divorced, give only your portion of assets and debts. Assets value and Debt are to be reported as of the date the 2022-2023 Free Application for Federal Student Aid (FAFSA) was filed.
